title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region residency and tighten audit logging for privileged actions
author: Sofia Martinez
ci_checks: ci/build: pass; ci/unit-tests: pass; ci/integration-tests: pass (flaky test retried once); ci/lint: pass; ci/sec-scan: pass; post-merge pipeline: scheduled
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS-backed keys and add explicit region-residency checks + improved audit logging for privileged operations. This PR implements: (1) a policy enforcement hook that rejects creation/attachment of customer-managed KMS keys outside of allowed regions for a given org/project; (2) an audit event enrichment for KMS key usage and RBAC policy changes (includes key id, key region, request initiator role, and resolved policy snapshot id); (3) migration helper that flags existing keys that violate residency (non-blocking during rollout) and emits remediation recommendations; (4) tests and e2e scenario harness updates. Changes are intended to be backward-compatible at the API level. We add a feature flag (rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforcement) and a migration mode (audit-only | enforce) to allow staged rollouts. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and compliance acceptance criteria. Checklist: - [x] new enforcement hook and region check - [x] audit event enrichment + schema change (versioned) - [x] migration script and admin CLI flag - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] console UI labels for flagged keys - [x] docs and release notes.

author_replies: Agree on provider SDK abstraction - moved region lookups behind kms/provider.Interface and added a mock in tests.
Coordinated with SIEM team, added 'audit_schema_version' field and noted forward/compatibility in docs.
Added CSV export flag to admin scanner and a summary metrics counter for flagged keys.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency policies for RBAC v2 (feature gated). Adds audit-enriched events for KMS and RBAC changes. Includes migration scanner and admin CLI to flag non-compliant keys. Rollout should be done in audit-only mode before enabling enforcement.
post_merge_tasks: Enable feature flag in staging (audit-only) and run migration scanner
Schedule canary enforcement for 3 pilot orgs
Add console remediation action (bulk-rotate/export) in next sprint
notes: This PR addresses multiple audit findings from recent compliance review. The enforcement hook validates region using the KMS provider's DescribeKey API (abstracted) and consults per-org residency policy. When enforcement is disabled, actions are logged with reason: 'audit-only'. Tests include happy path, cross-region key attempts, and race conditions for concurrent policy updates.
incident_links: SUP-2341: customer reported cross-region KMS misconfig - root cause: missing residency validation
backout_plan: Feature flag controlled; if production regressions observed, flip rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforcement to false and run remediation scripts to revert flagged changes. DB schema changes are additive (audit schema version) and support forward/backward compatibility.
notes_for_ops: Monitor metric rbac.kms_residency.violations and audit_events.rbac_kms_enriched. Pager runbook updated. SIEM ingestion team to be contacted after staged rollout.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover policy evaluation, region parsing, and audit enrichment. Integration tests exercise admin scanner against a mocked KMS provider. E2E smoke ran in staging with a seeded non-compliant key set. One flaky test intermittently in integration was retried once and passed.
security_review: Security review completed; no secrets are logged. Audit enrichment intentionally excludes raw key material and only logs key ids and regions. Compliance signed off pending staged rollout.
ui_changes: Console now marks keys as 'Residency: non-compliant' with a tooltip and provides a one-click export/CSV for remediation. Added console copystrings and small KeyDetails component update.
migration_notes: Migration is non-blocking. Admin CLI 'kms-scanner --mode=audit-only' will emit a CSV placed in /var/admin-exports by default. Recommend running scanner for all orgs and reviewing flagged keys prior to enforcement.
